'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
